race.comment: Open race. TAHNEE TERRITORY (5) has been freshened up since ending a run of top three finishes with a sixth over 1250m at Morphettville Parks six weeks ago. Good fresh performer who races best for Kayla Crowther - she is back aboard today. VANLEE (9) returns from an 18-week spell which followed a brief and disappointing campaign in the Autumn. Placed three from four when fresh so she cannot be ruled out. XTRAMAGIC (12) has been in the money at all three runs here. Worth keeping in mind. FILL A PROMISE (1) was below par two back at Morphettville then bounced back with a win over 1050m at the same track last time out. Can feature. CANNY MISS (6) finds a tougher race but can challenge.
